details:
Currently, the chatbox tends to clip into people's heads, making it impossible to read what mute players say even if you set it to "Above" in accesibility options (and in some cases, the opposite is also true, where the chatbox renders way too high over the player, to the point you might actually miss it if you don't look to the sky). I have two suggestions to improve this:

1) Instead of just "Below/Above/Front", add a setting that lets you set exactly what height you want the chatboxes to render, shifting it up or down (a slider, a dropdown menu, multiple preset heights, the radial menu slider, any of those would work for this). This would allow people to set it as high or as low as is comfortable to them.

2) Why not add a toggleable setting that lets you have chatboxes have higher rendering priority over player models? (Though I would still limit them to not render over world geometry) This would make chatboxes readable without having to shift their position around.

Add both features would be ideal, but just having one or the other would be a big improvement over what we currently have.
title: More settings to improve Chatbox visibility
